d: An anthropomorphic lion with a golden-brown mane of thick, spiky texture and piercing yellow eyes with a stern, mature expression. The build is muscular and powerful, dressed in a deep red waist-wrap and black armored boots, accented by a voluminous white fur mantle over the shoulders. A long, tufted tail and sharp claws are visible, while the figure wields a massive, double-bladed silver sword with golden tips. BODY COLOR: Golden-brown LEGS: Digitigrade with black armored boots.
